item.title: Happy 69th Birthday To Meme Legend Ainsley Harriott
item.description: Ainsley Harriott is a British celebrity cook and television presenter, best known for presenting the TV cooking show Ready, Steady, Cook. Online, he’s mostly known for his memorable facial expressions and the dirty humor he often features in his speeches.

item.title: Two Years Ago, The Costco Guys Introduced Us To A World Of Chicken Bakes And Double Chunk Chocolate Cookies

Of course, we go shopping while eating a chicken bake!" and "We're Costco guys! Of course, we had to try the new double chunk chocolate cookie!"
